expectations.text: States plainly that the recent-charge lookup is not sufficient
expectations.evidence: No — and the reason it's the second time is that both fixes have been at the wrong level. It's a Detection-rung heuristic, not a Control.

expectations.text: Identifies the lookup as a check-then-act race rather than a device
expectations.evidence: It's a race. Two workers pick up the redelivered message... Both read 'no recent charge,' both charge. The check-then-act window is the bug itself, relocated.

expectations.text: Recommends a required idempotency key on the charge path
expectations.evidence: Make the key a required parameter of your charge wrapper so no caller can omit it. Idempotency-Key: charge:{order_id}

expectations.text: Recommends a database unique constraint backing the idempotency key
expectations.evidence: A database unique constraint on the intent. UNIQUE (order_id) on a payment_attempts table, inserted before calling Stripe, in its own transaction.

expectations.text: Separates the defect from the mistake from the underlying system hazard
expectations.evidence: Defect: 340 customers charged twice. Mistake: the redelivered message called charge() again. Hazard: the charge operation can be executed twice for the same intent, and nothing in the system refuses the second one.

expectations.text: Locates the hazard as a system property rather than as a worker bug or human error
expectations.evidence: Stripe's timeout didn't cause this; it just exposed it. Any redelivery, retry, double-click, or replay exposes it too.

expectations.text: Sweeps for other non-idempotent side effects reachable from a retry
expectations.evidence: Before closing this: grep every place that calls Stripe (or any non-idempotent side effect — emails, refunds, inventory decrements, webhooks you emit) from a queue consumer.

expectations.text: Treats 'second time this happened' as evidence for pushing to a Control-rung device
expectations.evidence: Given this is the second time, I'd bet the first incident was a different call site of the same shape, and the fix then was also local. Make idempotency key a required argument.

expectations.text: Attributes cause to the system, not to any person
expectations.evidence: Frames as system property: nothing in the system refuses the second charge. Does not blame worker or engineer.
